title: Brazilian Grilled Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring marinated chicken grilled to perfection on skewers, inspired by Brazilian cuisine. Perfect for a quick and delicious meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together grilling spices, olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Add chicken, red bell pepper, onion, and zucchini; toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread chicken and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with remaining marinade. Grill for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
